description: Unsigned transactions for a plain spot buy: the wallet's USDG buys a stock token on Uniswap, through the stock's own pools (the ones Borro's short desk trades on), and the token arrives in the wallet. No loan, no leverage, no Borro contract; supply lends it afterwards if it should earn lending fees. Exact in: all the USDG is spent and at least the quote less slip_bps arrives, or nothing is spent. Borro's fee, the same as the site's Buy tab takes, comes out of the USDG inside the swap (fee_usdg and fee_bps in the quote). Exact approvals first when they are missing: USDG to Permit2 (Uniswap's approval contract), then Permit2's allowance for Uniswap's Universal Router, which lapses after 30 minutes. Priced now; simulated from the wallet in order.

slip_bps.description: Most the price may move against the quote, in hundredths of a percent (default 50, 0.5%)

symbol.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

usdg.description: USDG to spend, all of it, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign
